title: CountyPremiums
description: Crop insurance total premium per year, county and crop, from RMA's summary of business. Published by the pipeline as county-premiums.json; the UI reads it.

county_fips.description: State and county FIPS code, e.g. 19153.

crop.description: Crop name spelled as in county-losses.json, e.g. CORN, so the two files join on year, county_fips and crop.

premium.description: Total Premium Amount in whole dollars. Unique per year, county_fips and crop.
